user.title: Nutrition
user.description: Food intake is logged by an AI agent (the Nutrition MCP API) or by the ha_nutrition services. Optionally pick where calorie burn, BMR and weight come from, for net balance, budget left and distance to target weight. The Samsung Health sensors are pre-filled when that integration is set up.

data_description.burn_entity: A sensor with today's total burn so far (kcal), from any integration.
data_description.bmr_entity: A sensor with your basal metabolic rate (kcal/day), used to forecast the rest of the day.
data_description.weight_entity: A sensor with your current weight (kg).
data_description.burn_statistic: Optional statistic id of daily burn, for burn and net in past days. Leave empty to use the burn sensor's own statistics (sensors with state_class total or total_increasing).

legacy_statistics.title: Nutrition history moved to the sensors

confirm.title: Remove the old daily statistics?
confirm.description:
Daily intake, protein, saturated fat and alcohol now live on the Nutrition today sensors themselves, with every logged day, and that history has been checked. The old statistics `ha_nutrition:kcal`, `ha_nutrition:protein`, `ha_nutrition:sat_fat`, `ha_nutrition:alcohol` and the per-category `ha_nutrition:kcal_…` statistics are no longer updated. The breakdown per category stays available from the log (get_nutrition) and today's on the Intake today sensor.

Take a backup of Home Assistant first: removing them can't be undone.
